summary: The user's new in-place CodeGraph policy materially changes the shared trusted workspace capability accepted for Story 18.2. The current lease grants only contained physical-root access and rejects in-root disposable state; it does not grant a purpose-bound .codegraph write capability or positive application-owned binding. The Parallel Development schedule confirmed Story 18.2 owns the shared lease/types/tests, Story 18.3 owns CodeGraph adapter/index/session and source-reader/continuation repair, with 18.8 and 18.12 downstream. Reconcile FR-011 and affected spec/plan/task design, preserving 18.1 public read semantics and separate JDT-LS state, then rerun affected deterministic checks, independent reviews and approvals before shared implementation. The current T010 device-URI assertion also lacks a faithful System.Uri stimulus; design must decide how the raw protocol string is validated before the test can be claimed. Existing verified code/tests and recovery episode count6/pause7 remain intact; no CodeGraph write or JDT launch is authorized by this analysis.
